image_description:
## 1) Chart type
- **Top:** Stacked area chart (time series) showing foreign-born share of the population by region of origin.
- **Bottom:** County-level **choropleth map** of the United States.

## 2) Layout techniques
- The figure uses a **two-panel vertical layout**:
  - **Top panel:** stacked areas over time.
  - **Bottom panel:** geographic choropleth.
- The top chart uses **stacking** by region of origin.
- No faceting or small multiples are used.

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Year / time | Temporal | Position on x-axis (top chart) |
| Foreign-born share of population | Quantitative | Position on y-axis and stacked area height (top chart) |
| Region of origin (Europe, Asia, Latin America, Other) | Categorical/nominal | Color/fill of stacked areas; right-side labels |
| Total foreign-born share | Quantitative | Top boundary/line of stacked area; text annotation at 2017 |
| U.S. county | Categorical/nominal (geographic unit) | Geographic position and county polygons on map |
| Percentage change in foreign-born share of the population by county, 1990–2017 | Quantitative | Color/lightness of county fill on choropleth; legend |
| Policy event annotations (1921 quotas, 1965 policy change) | Temporal / textual annotation | Text labels and leader lines positioned at specific years in the top chart |
